turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (1 to 30 September) a social lead cost 52.50 EUR and a search lead cost 42.07 EUR per lead (cost per lead, EUR), so social cost about 10.43 EUR more per lead. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
